BGCODE uploads now work across browser u: BGCODE uploads now work across browser upload and revision flows, exact-limit uploads reach precise validation, and completed ingestion refreshes the library without stale tasks or previews
Remote storage, capture, authentication,: Remote storage, capture, authentication, sharing, printer administration, and cleanup paths now fail closed around credentials, ownership, provider identity, and deletion authority
API startup, shared domain packages, fro: API startup, shared domain packages, frontend tooling, and release gates now validate local-first SQLite, PostgreSQL, storage-provider contracts, browser workflows, and amd64 or arm64 full and lite images
